name: skillgraph
description: SkillGraph — AI-Powered Student Skill Graph and Career Pathway Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "fe,be,ml" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.seed: npm run seed --prefix backend && npm run seed:demo --prefix backend
scripts.seed:reset: npm run seed:reset --prefix backend && npm run seed:demo --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:ml
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
